description:
Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI.

Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Features:
- 💯 Connect to one or more clusters simultaneously
- ⚡️ Aggregated Log Viewer
- ⚖️ Resource Diff
- ✌️ Multi-Namespace Selector
- 💪 Human-friendly resource view
- ✍️ View & modify objects
- 🎉 Zero-config setup
- 😉 NOT another Electron app
- ✅ Works with any Kubernetes cluster: on-prem, GKE, EKS, AKS and others.
- 💻 Available on Windows, macOS and Linux
✨ New
- Log Viewer: Added the option to view logs from pods of multiple Deployments/ReplicaSets/DaemonSet/StatefulSet. Just select two or more deployments and press L (or Right Click > Logs)
- Log Viewer: Added an EOF log entry when a container exits and won't restart.
- macOS: Add New Window and list of windows to macOS dock menu #349
- YAML Editor: Added a temporary/experimental feature to change the field manager name when making updates to an object #580
- PodTemplate: Added basic support for PodTemplate Discord
💎 Improvements
- Log Viewer: Improved how we render the Mark (when pressing space), which now works well with all selected options (line wrap, different timestamp formats)
- Ingress: Add Copy button to Ingress Rules #582
🐞 Fixes
- Log Viewer: Fix a bug where unselecting a container would not clear the logs Discord
- YAML Editor: Fixed an issue where horizontal scroll was not working even though the scrollbar was visible #581
